text:
The afternoon wakes from its dream,

when the wing-light cloud begins singing...

A cloud of wings... a joyful cloud that descends, that rises...


It is they. They move away between plain and sky.

They are the emeralds of a necklace in flight...


Noisily they trace a green curve in the air,

Are they going to the palm groves of waving fan?

They go wherever their beaks point them.

They move away, they move away... but they go so together,

that rather they seem lines of dots...


And they fall in a plain,

as when a tree is shedding its leaves.

translation.title: The Parakeets Pass
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the parakeets as a winged green necklace and then a falling tree.
